existing_features.title: Add offline support for the PWA by implementing a service worker that precaches the app shell and provides a clear offline fallback behavior when the network is unavailable.
Improve caching/performance via a smarter service-worker caching strategy (e.g., precache for core assets and appropriate runtime caching rules) to reduce load time and improve repeat visits.
Create and integrate a custom PWA splash screen that matches the app branding, including iOS startup images and required metadata/link tags.
Implement a better install prompt UX: provide a more noticeable, helpful install entry point and guidance for platforms where the native `beforeinstallprompt` is unavailable (e.g., iOS).

Polish the standalone (installed) layout so the PWA feels native: handle safe-area insets, prevent awkward scrolling/overflow, and ensure header/navigation spacing looks correct in standalone mode on mobile.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add offline support for the PWA (service worker + offline fallback behavior)
Create and integrate a custom splash screen matching the app icon/branding
Improve load performance via smarter caching strategy (service worker caching optimization)
Implement a better install prompt UX to encourage Add-to-Home-Screen installs
Polish standalone layout/experience so the PWA feels more native when installed
